cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: an apiary on a flowery hill — rows of white bee boxes, a smoker can, a honey-extractor drum and wildflowers
cuts.scene: she is the owner of the apiary holding a jar of golden honey up to the light
cuts.outfit: a beekeeper look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved beekeeper jacket cut at the waist over short shorts with a veiled hat, bare arms and legs, a golden honey-drop brooch on her veil
